beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That recurring structure connects the trilogy's metaphysical invention with recognizable obligations.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its worlds become interesting through the lives their arrangements enable or constrain.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Across its three volumes, the novel changes the scale of the same difficulty.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Greater power does not remove the consequences of defining someone else's existence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its realms depend on agreements, allocations, histories, and vulnerable continuities.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That gives its expansive invention a recurring ethical center.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with The Dark One and the laboratory exchange that demands interpretation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: OMNIS rewards readers who want metaphysical adventure to remain answerable to particular lives.
